findings.message: chooseSigil re-renders the whole profile, and renderProfile writes elements.profileCallsign.value from the saved progress, so a callsign the player typed but has not saved is silently discarded when they pick a sigil. Preserve the typed value across the re-render.

saveCallsign refreshes the profile view and the title stats but never calls updateTopbarStatus, so the topbar keeps showing the old 'OPERATOR / <callsign>' until the player changes screens. Refresh the topbar after a successful save.

The victory timer only opens the dialog while state.screen is still 'game'; if the player opens the profile (P) during the 520 ms delay, the dialog is skipped and returning to the game never reopens it, so the chamber-complete dialog and its Next/Begin Episode action are lost for that run.
